notes.title: Hotfix: Fullscreen bug
notes.content: Game would start in fullscreen at the wrong resolution, Overdrawn will now default to Maximized Window until the issue is fixed.

notes.title: Post Launch Update #3
notes.content:
New Features

Added volume controls for Sound FX and Music

Added a Fullscreen toggle option in the settings menu

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug with the Mirror One card not functioning correctly

DNA descriptions now only display if you have more than one DNA active

Fixed an issue where returning to the Main Menu during Character Select and then resuming the game would cause the character screen to appear blank

notes.title: Post Launch Update #2
notes.content:
Bug Fix: Leaderboard position text now displays correctly.

Bug Fix: Diablo now correctly adds Burn cards only on odd turns, as intended.

Main Menu Improvements:

Returning to the main menu no longer restarts the game.

Added option to continue your run from the main menu.

Option to restart the game is now included in the main menu.

Card Draw Adjustment:

You can now draw cards as long as there's room in your hand.

"Hand size" now refers to your starting hand size, not the maximum limit.

notes.title: Post Launch Update #1
notes.content: Fixing bug on leaderboards where it was only displaying one entry.
